dedupe_keys.name: west wastewater treatment process modelling software dhi mike

description: WEST is DHI's simulation tool for dynamic modelling of wastewater treatment plants, aimed at operators, engineers and researchers. It simulates physical, biological and chemical processes to refine plant design, operations and automation, optimising effluent quality, energy use and cost, and includes uncertainty and sensitivity analysis. Users can evaluate new or existing plants with predefined and custom indicators, compare design alternatives under dynamic conditions for effluent quality and investment and operating costs, build plant-wide models, and extend the open model and block libraries with custom unit processes and control systems. It also supports digital twins with dashboards for operators and long, less computationally heavy simulations of integrated catchment, collection system and receiving water systems to predict plant inflows and solids loads in dry and wet weather. Coverage is not tied to a place. Access is through a DHI licence requested from the page, in the MIKE 2026 release, with academic licences. Caveats: prices and licence terms are not given on the page. Simulation uses: plant capacity and upgrade design, control optimisation and wastewater digital twins. Related records: the IWA benchmark simulation models (model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models), WaterTAP (model-watertap) and ASIM (model-eawag-asim-activated-sludge-simulation).
